description.short_caption: Peripheral blood smear showing a neutrophil with intracellular inclusions.
description.detailed_description: This is a high-magnification image of a peripheral blood smear. The smear shows numerous red blood cells, most of which appear normocytic and normochromic. A single neutrophil is visible in the center of the field, containing prominent intracellular inclusions that are purple-stained. The staining technique highlights cellular details, suggesting the use of a Romanowsky-type stain (e.g., Wright-Giemsa).
